mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_fork_current_status (forklift_id, fork_state, limit_bottom, error_code, message_at, received_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{forkliftId}, #{forkState}, #{limitBottom}, #{errorCode}, #{messageAt}, #{receivedAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fork_state = VALUES(fork_state), limit_bottom = VALUES(limit_bottom), error_code = VALUES(error_code), message_at = VALUES(message_at), received_at = VALUES(received_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
